decisions.reason: The same source message already establishes remote hosting of heavy tutorial and graphic assets for Android through the existing MODIFY, with no missing or stale attributes.
The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE that fully records external hosting as the tutorial and graphic-content delivery mechanism.
Moving tutorial and graphic assets outside the iOS package does not necessarily change localization coverage or RTL layout support.
The asset-hosting decision does not necessarily change the Android localization workflow.
